set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWY8W7DP7TBKH918WVRG20YW. Problem: addInput/addStep is type-safe but too raw for real users. Implement a small builder facade over immutable PipelineGraph with typed input/step/output authoring, preserving the existing graph core. Acceptance: builder API composes inputs, step refs, constants, zipped expressions, and named outputs; builder failures return PipelineError; JVM/JS tests cover a small branched graph.
set.title: Pipeline: add ergonomic typed graph builder
